title: Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.00708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.   We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. translated_title: 超越单模态基底：面向多模态数据的拉回几何
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的黎曼几何为高维数据提供了非线性插值和几何表示。为了使这些操作在统计上有意义，观测点之间的路径应优先穿过高似然区域。现有的可扩展拉回构造通常使用单峰高斯隐分布，假设数据位于单一流形附近。对于多模态数据，将彼此分离的模态或局部结构映射到单一高斯区域可能需要大量的传输变形，并损害所得到的几何结构。我们为支撑在流形混合上的数据引入了一种拉回几何。利用隐高斯混合模型，我们将其黎曼度量定义为责任加权期望分量精度的矩阵平方。该度量是光滑且正定的，并在单分量极限下恢复现有的高斯构造。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于隐高斯混合模型的拉回几何方法，将黎曼度量定义为责任加权期望分量精度的矩阵平方，从而为支撑在流形混合上的多模态数据构建光滑、正定且具有统计意义的几何表示。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a pullback geometry based on a latent Gaussian mixture, defining the Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision, enabling smooth, positive-definite, and statistically meaningful geometric representations for multimodal data supported on mixtures of manifolds.
